fusions.name: Upthrown Ridge
fusions.desc: Drags up a jagged ridge 6 tiles long that stands for 6 seconds. It deals 12 damage to each enemy that crosses it and stuns it for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Clod Breaker
fusions.desc: Brings the tines down for 8 damage, leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Heaped Berm
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Grit Underfoot
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you deal 20% more physical damage for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
